description: Reclaim disk and memory from developer caches, build folders, AI models, processes and ports.
notes: Portable mode: the bundled 'portable' marker makes Dev Cleaner store settings, window state and WebView2 data in the 'data' folder beside the exe. This manifest persists that folder, so scoop update and scoop uninstall (without -p) keep it.
The app is not code-signed. SmartScreen may say Windows protected your PC; choose More info, then Run anyway.
Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which current Windows 10 and Windows 11 already include.
Use scoop update dev-cleaner. The portable build has no separate installer-managed updater.
